entries.input: If complex sequences $s_n \to s$ and $t_n \to t$, then $s_n + t_n \to s + t$ and $s_n t_n \to st$.
entries.name: LimitOfSumAndProduct
entries.binders: (s t : ℕ → ℂ) (a b : ℂ) (hs : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds a)) (ht : Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds b))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => s n + t n) Filter.atTop (nhds (a + b)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => s n * t n) Filter.atTop (nhds (a * b))

entries.input: If a complex sequence $s_n \to s$ with every $s_n \neq 0$ and $s \neq 0$, then $1/s_n \to 1/s$.
entries.name: LimitOfReciprocal
entries.binders: (s : ℕ → ℂ) (a : ℂ) (hs : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds a)) (h0 : ∀ n, s n ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (s n)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds a⁻¹)

entries.input: A sequence in $\mathbb{R}^k$ converges to $\mathbf{x}$ if and only if each coordinate sequence converges to the corresponding coordinate of $\mathbf{x}$.
entries.name: ConvergenceInEuclideanSpaceIsCoordinatewise
entries.binders: (k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (l : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds l) ↔ ∀ j, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => x n j) Filter.atTop (nhds (l j))

entries.input: Every bounded sequence in $\mathbb{R}^k$ has a convergent subsequence.
entries.name: BolzanoWeierstrassSequences
entries.binders: (k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range x))
entries.conclusion: ∃ (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧ Filter.Tendsto (x ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
entries.title: Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem for sequences

entries.input: In $\mathbb{R}^k$ every Cauchy sequence converges.
entries.name: EuclideanSpaceComplete
entries.binders: (k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (hx : CauchySeq x)
entries.conclusion: ∃ p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds p)
entries.title: Cauchy criterion

entries.input: A monotonically increasing real sequence converges if and only if it is bounded above.
entries.name: MonotoneSequenceConvergesIffBounded
entries.binders: (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs : Monotone s)
entries.conclusion: (∃ l, Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds l)) ↔ BddAbove (Set.range s)

entries.input: For $p > 0$, $1/n^p \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: ReciprocalPowerTendsToZero
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.input: For $p > 0$, $p^{1/n} \to 1$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: NthRootOfConstantTendsToOne
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => p ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

entries.input: $n^{1/n} \to 1$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: NthRootOfNTendsToOne
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: For $p > 0$ and real $\alpha$, $n^\alpha / (1 + p)^n \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: PolynomialOverExponentialTendsToZero
entries.binders: (p α : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ α / (1 + p) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.input: If $|x| < 1$ then $x^n \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: GeometricSequenceTendsToZero
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.input: A series $\sum a_n$ of complex numbers converges if and only if for every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is $N$ such that $\bigl|\sum_{k=n}^m a_k\bigr| \leq \varepsilon$ whenever $m \geq n \geq N$.
entries.name: CauchyCriterionForSeries
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ)
entries.conclusion: (∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n : ℕ, N ≤ n → n ≤ m → ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc n m, a k‖ ≤ ε

entries.input: If the series $\sum a_n$ of complex numbers converges, then $a_n \to 0$.
entries.name: TermsOfConvergentSeriesTendToZero
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (h : ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.input: A series of nonnegative real terms converges if and only if its partial sums form a bounded sequence.
entries.name: NonnegativeSeriesConvergesIffPartialSumsBounded
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
entries.conclusion: (∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ↔ BddAbove (Set.range (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k))

entries.input: Let $a_n$ be complex and $c_n$ real with $|a_n| \leq c_n$ for all $n \geq N_0$. If $\sum c_n$ converges, so does $\sum a_n$.
entries.name: ComparisonTest
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (h : ∀ n ≥ N₀, ‖a n‖ ≤ c n) (hc : Summable c)
entries.conclusion: ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
entries.title: Comparison test
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, fun _ _ => by simp, summable_zero, trivial⟩

entries.input: Let $a_n \geq d_n \geq 0$ for all $n \geq N_0$. If $\sum d_n$ diverges, so does $\sum a_n$.
entries.name: ComparisonTestDivergence
entries.binders: (a d : ℕ → ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) (h : ∀ n ≥ N₀, d n ≤ a n) (hd : ∀ n, 0 ≤ d n) (hdiv : ¬ Summable d)
entries.conclusion: ¬ Summable a
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a = d = 1`, `N₀ = 0`; that the constant series diverges is `summable_const_iff`, not a one-line term.

entries.input: For $0 \leq x < 1$, $\sum_{n \geq 0} x^n = 1/(1 - x)$; for $x \geq 1$ the series diverges.
entries.name: GeometricSeries
entries.conclusion: (x < 1 → HasSum (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) (1 - x)⁻¹) ∧ (1 ≤ x → ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n))

entries.input: Let $a_1 \geq a_2 \geq \dots \geq 0$. Then $\sum a_n$ converges if and only if $\sum_k 2^k a_{2^k}$ converges.
entries.name: CauchyCondensationTest
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (h0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
entries.conclusion: Summable a ↔ Summable (fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ k * a (2 ^ k))
entries.title: Cauchy condensation test

entries.input: The series $\sum_{n \geq 1} 1/n^p$ converges if and only if $p > 1$.
entries.name: PSeries
entries.binders: (p : ℝ)
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) ↔ 1 < p
entries.title: p-series

entries.input: The series $\sum_{n \geq 2} 1/(n (\log n)^p)$ converges if and only if $p > 1$.
entries.name: LogPSeries
entries.binders: (p : ℝ)
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n ^ p)) ↔ 1 < p

entries.input: $(1 + 1/n)^n \to e$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: EulerLimitForE
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 + 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp 1))
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: Let $\sum a_n$ be a complex series and suppose $|a_n|^{1/n} \to \alpha$. If $\alpha < 1$ the series converges; if $\alpha > 1$ it diverges.
entries.name: RootTest
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖a n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds α))
entries.conclusion: (α < 1 → ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ∧ (1 < α → ¬ (∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)))
entries.title: Root test
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a = 0`, `α = 0`: the terms `‖0‖^(1/n)` vanish for `n ≥ 1`; not a one-line term because the `n = 0` term is `0^0 = 1`.

entries.input: Let $\sum a_n$ be a complex series with $a_n \neq 0$ and suppose $|a_{n+1}/a_n| \to \alpha$. If $\alpha < 1$ the series converges; if $|a_{n+1}| \geq |a_n|$ for all large $n$ it diverges.
entries.name: RatioTest
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0)
entries.conclusion: (∀ α : ℝ, α < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖a (n + 1)‖ / ‖a n‖) Filter.atTop (nhds α) → ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ∧ ((∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ‖a n‖ ≤ ‖a (n + 1)‖) → ¬ (∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)))
entries.title: Ratio test

entries.input: Let $a_n, b_n$ be complex and $A_n = \sum_{k < n} a_k$. Then $\sum_{k < n} a_k b_k = A_n b_{n-1} - \sum_{k < n-1} A_{k+1}(b_{k+1} - b_k)$.
entries.name: SummationByParts
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ)
entries.conclusion: ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k * b k = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) * b (n - 1) - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a j) * (b (k + 1) - b k)
entries.title: Abel summation

entries.input: Suppose the partial sums of the complex series $\sum a_n$ are bounded, and $b_n$ is a decreasing real sequence tending to $0$. Then $\sum a_n b_n$ converges.
entries.name: DirichletTest
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (hA : ∃ M, ∀ n, ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k‖ ≤ M) (hb : Antitone b) (hb0 : Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
entries.conclusion: ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k * b k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
entries.title: Dirichlet's test
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, ⟨0, fun _ => by simp⟩, antitone_const, tendsto_const_nhds, trivial⟩

entries.input: If $c_n$ is a decreasing real sequence tending to $0$, then $\sum (-1)^n c_n$ converges.
entries.name: AlternatingSeriesTest
entries.binders: (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : Antitone c) (h0 : Filter.Tendsto c Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
entries.conclusion: ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * c k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
entries.title: Leibniz test

entries.input: If $\sum |a_n|$ converges, then $\sum a_n$ converges.
entries.name: AbsoluteConvergenceImpliesConvergence
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (h : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖))
entries.conclusion: ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)

entries.input: If $\sum a_n = A$ and $\sum b_n = B$ then $\sum (a_n + b_n) = A + B$, and $\sum c a_n = cA$ for every constant $c$.
entries.name: SumOfConvergentSeries
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (A B c : ℂ) (ha : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds A)) (hb : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, b k) Filter.atTop (nhds B))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (a k + b k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (A + B)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, c * a k) Filter.atTop (nhds (c * A))
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, 0, 0, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, trivial⟩

entries.input: If $\sum a_n$ converges absolutely with sum $A$ and $\sum b_n$ converges with sum $B$, then the Cauchy product $\sum c_n$, $c_n = \sum_{k \leq n} a_k b_{n-k}$, converges to $AB$.
entries.name: MertensTheorem
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (A B : ℂ) (ha : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖)) (hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds A)) (hB : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, b k) Filter.atTop (nhds B))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a k * b (m - k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (A * B))
entries.title: Mertens' theorem
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, 0, by simpa using summable_zero, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, trivial⟩

entries.input: If $\sum a_n$, $\sum b_n$ and their Cauchy product $\sum c_n$ all converge, with sums $A$, $B$, $C$, then $C = AB$.
entries.name: AbelCauchyProduct
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (A B C : ℂ) (hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds A)) (hB : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, b k) Filter.atTop (nhds B)) (hC : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a k * b (m - k)) Filter.atTop (nhds C))
entries.conclusion: C = A * B
entries.title: Abel's theorem on Cauchy products
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, 0, 0, 0, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds, trivial⟩

entries.input: Let $\sum a_n$ be a real series that converges but not absolutely, and let $-\infty \leq \alpha \leq \beta \leq \infty$. There is a rearrangement whose partial sums have lower limit $\alpha$ and upper limit $\beta$.
entries.name: RiemannRearrangement
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hconv : ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) (habs : ¬ Summable a) (α β : EReal) (hαβ : α ≤ β)
entries.conclusion: ∃ σ : ℕ ≃ ℕ, Filter.liminf (fun n => ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a (σ k) : ℝ) : EReal)) Filter.atTop = α ∧ Filter.limsup (fun n => ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a (σ k) : ℝ) : EReal)) Filter.atTop = β
entries.title: Riemann rearrangement theorem
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: the alternating harmonic series with `α = β = 0`; the non-absolute-convergence proof is not a one-liner, so no closed term is recorded.

entries.input: If $\sum a_n$ converges absolutely, every rearrangement of it converges to the same sum.
entries.name: RearrangementOfAbsolutelyConvergentSeries
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (h : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖)) (σ : ℕ ≃ ℕ)
entries.conclusion: ∑' n, a (σ n) = ∑' n, a n
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, by simpa using summable_zero, Equiv.refl ℕ, trivial⟩

entries.input: If a real sequence $s_n$ converges to $s$, then $|s_n|$ converges to $|s|$.
entries.name: ConvergenceImpliesConvergenceOfAbsoluteValues
entries.binders: (s : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ) (h : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds l))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |s n|) Filter.atTop (nhds |l|)

entries.input: $\sqrt{n^2 + n} - n \to 1/2$ as $n \to \infty$.
entries.name: LimitSqrtNSquaredPlusNMinusN
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 + n) - n) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: Let $s_1 = \sqrt 2$ and $s_{n+1} = \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{s_n}}$. Then $s_n < 2$ for all $n$ and the sequence converges.
entries.name: NestedRadicalSequenceConverges
entries.binders: (s : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : s 0 = Real.sqrt 2) (hs : ∀ n, s (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt (s n)))
entries.conclusion: (∀ n, s n < 2) ∧ ∃ l, Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds l)
entries.witness: ⟨fun n => Nat.rec (Real.sqrt 2) (fun _ t => Real.sqrt (2 + Real.sqrt t)) n, rfl, fun _ => rfl, trivial⟩

entries.input: For bounded real sequences $a_n$ and $b_n$, $\limsup (a_n + b_n) \leq \limsup a_n + \limsup b_n$.
entries.name: LimsupOfSumLeSumOfLimsups
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range a)) (hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range b))
entries.conclusion: Filter.limsup (fun n => a n + b n) Filter.atTop ≤ Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + Filter.limsup b Filter.atTop
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, by simp, by simp, trivial⟩

entries.input: The series $\sum (\sqrt{n+1} - \sqrt n)$ diverges.
entries.name: SqrtDifferencesSeriesDiverges
entries.conclusion: ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt (n + 1) - Real.sqrt n)
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: The series $\sum (\sqrt{n+1} - \sqrt n)/n$ converges.
entries.name: SqrtDifferencesOverNSeriesConverges
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Real.sqrt (n + 1) - Real.sqrt n) / n)
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: The series $\sum (n^{1/n} - 1)^n$ converges.
entries.name: NthRootMinusOnePowerSeriesConverges
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) - 1) ^ n)
entries.witness_note: Closed statement; no hypotheses to witness.

entries.input: For complex $z$ with $1 + z^n \neq 0$ for all $n$, the series $\sum 1/(1 + z^n)$ converges absolutely if and only if $|z| > 1$.
entries.name: SeriesOneOverOnePlusZPow
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (1 + z ^ n)) ↔ 1 < ‖z‖
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `z = 2`, where `1 + 2^n` is a positive real; the complex-cast positivity argument is short but not a term.

entries.input: If $a_n \geq 0$ and $\sum a_n$ converges, then $\sum \sqrt{a_n}/n$ converges.
entries.name: SqrtAnOverNConverges
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (h : Summable a)
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt (a n) / n)

entries.input: If $\sum a_n$ converges and $b_n$ is a monotone bounded real sequence, then $\sum a_n b_n$ converges.
entries.name: AbelsTest
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) (hb : Monotone b ∨ Antitone b) (hbb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range b))
entries.conclusion: ∃ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k * b k) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
entries.title: Abel's test
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, ⟨0, by simp⟩, Or.inl monotone_const, by simp, trivial⟩

entries.input: If $a_n > 0$ and $\sum a_n$ diverges, then $\sum a_n/(1 + a_n)$ diverges.
entries.name: DivergentPositiveSeriesAnOverOnePlusAn
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hd : ¬ Summable a)
entries.conclusion: ¬ Summable (fun n => a n / (1 + a n))
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a n = 1`; the non-summability of the constant sequence is a short argument rather than a term.

entries.input: If $a_n > 0$, $\sum a_n$ diverges and $s_n = a_1 + \dots + a_n$, then $\sum a_n / s_n$ diverges.
entries.name: DivergentPositiveSeriesAnOverSn
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hd : ¬ Summable a)
entries.conclusion: ¬ Summable (fun n => a n / ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k)
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a n = 1`; see the sibling entry.

entries.input: If $a_n > 0$, $\sum a_n$ diverges and $s_n = a_1 + \dots + a_n$, then $\sum a_n / s_n^2$ converges.
entries.name: DivergentPositiveSeriesAnOverSnSquared
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hd : ¬ Summable a)
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n => a n / (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k) ^ 2)
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a n = 1`; see the sibling entry.

entries.input: If $a_n > 0$, $\sum a_n$ converges and $r_n = \sum_{m \geq n} a_m$, then $\sum a_n / r_n$ diverges.
entries.name: ConvergentPositiveSeriesAnOverTailDiverges
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hs : Summable a)
entries.conclusion: ¬ Summable (fun n => a n / ∑' m, a (m + n))
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a n = (1/2)^n`; the positivity and summability facts are standard but not a single closed term.

entries.input: If $a_n > 0$, $\sum a_n$ converges and $r_n = \sum_{m \geq n} a_m$, then $\sum a_n / \sqrt{r_n}$ converges.
entries.name: ConvergentPositiveSeriesAnOverSqrtTailConverges
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hs : Summable a)
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n => a n / Real.sqrt (∑' m, a (m + n)))
entries.witness_note: Satisfiable: `a n = (1/2)^n`; see the sibling entry.

entries.input: The Cauchy product of two absolutely convergent complex series converges absolutely.
entries.name: CauchyProductOfAbsolutelyConvergentSeries
entries.binders: (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖)) (hb : Summable (fun n => ‖b n‖))
entries.conclusion: Summable (fun n => ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a k * b (n - k)‖)
entries.witness: ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, by simpa using summable_zero, by simpa using summable_zero, trivial⟩

entries.input: If a real sequence $s_n$ converges to $s$, then its arithmetic means $\sigma_n = (s_0 + \dots + s_n)/(n+1)$ converge to $s$.
entries.name: CesaroMeansConverge
entries.binders: (s : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ) (h : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds l))
entries.conclusion: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), s k) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds l)
entries.title: Cesàro's theorem

entries.input: If $a_n \to 0$, then the series $\sum a_n$ converges.
entries.name: TermsTendingToZeroImpliesConvergence
entries.binders: (a : ℕ → ℂ) (h : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
